## Current Reality (true state now, especially stale-plan corrections; not action narration)

S21C is implemented. Core now owns a typed six-surface operational projection,
exact Bot/Group Scope authorization and dedicated mutation discovery. Model
Router and MCP/Capability consume existing immutable registry snapshots. Runs,
Plugin, Memory and Proactive remain explicit `unavailable` when no bounded
read-only provider is registered; neither Core nor Web invents health.

Python supplies explicit camelCase Web DTO projection, the framework-neutral
API exposes operations queries, and Node forwards the operator session through
an account-to-Bot scoped read-only route. The `/control-plane` Web view switches
between Group Service and Runtime Status. An operations transport failure clears
only that projection and does not block or reuse state in Group Onboarding.

Agent draft approval no longer calls NapCat, permission approval no longer
changes browser state, and unsupported Agent settings are disabled until a
dedicated Core Command exists. Human QQ workspace sends are unchanged.

## Recent Work (latest meaningful progress event and verification result; not a command log)
